rationale: Contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated 1 Jan - 31 Mar 2026, and this invoice is dated 12 Mar 2026; the PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH converts to exactly USD 231.00/EACH, matching the invoice (policy clauses 7 and 3 - conversion is normalisation, not a defect). Receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 of 40 EACH received (clause 4), and recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% rate is USD 693.00, identical to the billed figure (clause 5). No credit memos outstanding; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
